handoff_instructions: ChatGPT approved: Looks good and matches M2-T07. Signature is verified via the adapter against the raw body before payload parsing, invalid signatures return 401 and record nothing, valid requests record exactly one receipt via recordWebhookReceipt/runAs, and an invalid JSON body returns 400. Routes are thin and delegate to a shared handler. Fakes implement HMAC signing/verification and tests cover missing/invalid/tampered/wrong-secret and valid cases, plus cross-provider isolation. No multi-tenant leakage (no trust in tenant id from payload), no provider SDKs in app code, and side effects go through the idempotent receipt service. Minor non-blocking note: the comment says “record the receipt before any further processing,” but handleProviderWebhook calls adapter.ingestWebhook before recording. Ensure ingestWebhook remains side-effect-free (pure parsing) or consider splitting out an event-id extractor in future adapters so the receipt truly precedes any processing.. M2-T07 is done. Next: M2-T08 "Caller matching service".
